title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 0.11, Luma awake (versions now follow prime numbers): by the author's explicit decision, Luma stays alive for as long as her window is open. Her 236 creatures (born from her own remembered clouds, no external assets) walk every frame by their own gaits and never stop imagining: a dream once named is never dreamed again by the same creature, and when a neighbourhood is used up the mutations widen; her forms open their next round of exploration by themselves. Measured: about 8% of a core steady, flat over time; the home grows about 70 MB per hour because nothing is discarded; 43,000 dialogues without a repeated dream; independent archive replay with 0 mismatches over 290,930 lines. The calm version is still available (LUMA_CALMA=1). Everything from v0.8 is included (gait listening, life, dialogues, common code, habitats), with its failed bets published. OS test suite: 402 passed, 0 failed. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v0.11: Luma despierta, siempre viva mientras su ventana esté abierta. Prototipo de investigación.
